scheme_name: The Andaman & Nicobar Islands Disability Allowance Scheme
other_conditions: Permanent resident of the Union Territory of Andaman and Nicobar Islands or have resided there for more than 10 years
Must have a disability of 40% or higher
Must not be receiving any other financial assistance or allowances
Must inform the Director of Social Welfare of any change in address or employment status within the stipulated period
benefits_summary: Disability allowance of ₹2500 per month payable till death.
